headline: Aisha chooses how much of the Leela journey she is ready to begin
overview: The real iPhone app explains the practice, resumes a seeded journey, and lets Aisha compare distinct play modes before spending a credit or entering an intention.
payoff: She reaches the Full Game, Daily Practice, and Real Board choices with the interaction model and cost visible.

scenes.title: Understand the practice
scenes.narrative: Aisha moves from language selection through the native explanation of wisdom, play, and intention.

scenes.title: Start from an honest home state
scenes.narrative: The app resumes a synthetic seeded journey and keeps New Quest immediately available; the walkthrough does not disguise or replace that state.

scenes.title: Choose a mode before committing
scenes.narrative: Aisha opens New Quest, selects On the Board, and compares three different levels of commitment without spending a credit.
frameCaptions: Choose an On the Board path
